name: bizapps-collaboration
description: BizApps Collaboration — shared spaces for collaborative team and outside work.

scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test packages/Core/src/rules.test.ts packages/Core/src/phase0.test.ts packages/Core/src/view-models.test.ts packages/Core/src/configuration.test.ts packages/Core/src/retrieval.test.ts && pnpm --filter @mj-biz-apps/collaboration-engine-base test && pnpm --filter @mj-biz-apps/collaboration-core-entities-server run build && pnpm --filter @mj-biz-apps/collaboration-core-entities-server exec tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && pnpm --filter @mj-biz-apps/collaboration-integration-tests run build && node --test packages/CoreEntitiesServer/src/load-graph.test.ts packages/CoreEntitiesServer/src/upload-space-file.test.ts packages/CoreEntitiesServer/src/collaboration-file-store.test.ts packages/CoreEntitiesServer/src/file-root-task.test.ts packages/CoreEntitiesServer/src/task-space.test.ts packages/CoreEntitiesServer/src/space-entity-server.test.ts packages/CoreEntitiesServer/src/space-agent-retrieval.test.ts packages/CoreEntitiesServer/src/space-item-entity-server.test.ts packages/CoreEntitiesServer/src/resolve-allowed-agents.test.ts packages/CoreEntitiesServer/src/resolve-space-chat-host-rules.test.ts packages/CoreEntitiesServer/src/authorizations.test.ts packages/CoreEntitiesServer/src/room-edit-grants.test.ts packages/CoreEntitiesServer/src/execute-space-chat-turn.test.ts packages/CoreEntitiesServer/src/settings-chain.test.ts && pnpm --filter @mj-biz-apps/collaboration-integration-tests test && pnpm --filter @mj-biz-apps/collaboration-ng-widgets test && pnpm --filter @mj-biz-apps/collaboration-ng test && pnpm --filter @mj-biz-apps/collaboration-example-space-types test
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run test:integration:server && pnpm run test:integration:client
scripts.test:integration:server: node test-harnesses/integration.mjs 2>&1 | tee integration-server.log && node scripts/assert-check-count.mjs integration-server.log server
scripts.test:integration:client: node test-harnesses/integration-client.mjs 2>&1 | tee integration-client.log && node scripts/assert-check-count.mjs integration-client.log client
